subject: Flux-generated neutral full-length test photo (832 x 1040, fitted long-sleeve red dress, visible neck, hands and legs); no private user photos were used

problem_diagnosis.symptom: old garment color visible beside the neck after a clothing change
causes: the face protection's safety margin covered the collar edge, and protection always won
the inward edge fade kept partial original color at the selection boundary beside protected areas
with visible-skin protection, SAM's object and skin outlines leave a 1-2px strip that the skin margin kept original (red line at hem and cuffs)
problem_diagnosis.fix: the detected object plus the contested band toward faces/skin is fully replaced; a 2px fade (scaled with photo size) sits inside skin; faces keep their pixels apart from a 2px allowance; only extra room fades

seam_offline_reblend_same_flux_patches.note: Same raw Flux patches re-composited with different masks; counts are original-red pixels left within 10px of both the dress and protected skin
seam_offline_reblend_same_flux_patches.remaining_pixels: shadowed reddish skin inside the protected original (largest blob mean RGB 123,69,47), not dress color; no visible line at collar, cuffs or hem

summary.color_change: all variants kept the silhouette (IoU 0.994-0.997, <1px mean width change)
summary.interpretation: for the garment change, shape guidance reduced mean torso width drift by 16-20% versus the same masks without it (21-26% versus the previous behavior); a modest effect measured on two seeds of one subject, not a guarantee
summary.shape_guidance_timing: typical edits went from about 29-30s to 40-50s; one 135s run coincided with other work on the Mac and is treated as an outlier

sam3_skin_detection.observation: top skin detection covered face and both hands as one instance
